title: Maps out of tensor sections are determined on Zariski opens
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $\mathcal O_{\mathrm{et}}(u:V\to T)=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ its structure-ring sheaf. Use the Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site] and presheaves of modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Let $M$ be any Zariski $\mathcal O_T$-module and $G$ any sheaf of $\mathcal O_{\mathrm{et}}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $P_M$ be the module presheaf $P_M(u)=\Gamma(V,u^*M)$ with the unit-normalized restrictions [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] and pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $G_u(A)=G(A\hookrightarrow V\xrightarrow{u}T)$ for the Zariski module on $V$, for $A\subseteq V$ open, and $G_T(W)=G(W\hookrightarrow T)$. For $i_W:W\hookrightarrow T$, write $\kappa_W:M|_W\xrightarrow{\sim}i_W^*M$ for the unit-compatible comparison [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction]. For morphisms of module presheaves $\theta,\theta':P_M\to G$, if
$$\theta_{i_W}\circ\Gamma(W,\kappa_W)=\theta'_{i_W}\circ\Gamma(W,\kappa_W):M(W)\to G_T(W)$$
for every Zariski open $W\subseteq T$, then $\theta=\theta'$ on every object and arrow of $T_{\mathrm{et}}$. In other words, restriction to open subschemes is injective on the set of module-presheaf maps out of this specified $P_M$. No quasi-coherence, separation or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For each etale object U, let B_U consist of all normalized restrictions rho_f(e_W^{-1}(m)), with W a base open, m a section of M on W, and f:U to i_W. Naturality of theta and theta-prime gives theta_U(rho_f(e_W^{-1}(m)))=G(f)(theta_iW(e_W^{-1}(m))) and the corresponding equality for theta-prime. The open hypothesis makes these equal. Thus the two linear maps agree on B_U, and LinearMap.eqOn_span makes them agree on its span.

Fix V and s in P_M(V). Apply lem-trf-etale-tensor-sections-local-span to get a covering sieve S such that rho_g(s) belongs to the span of B_U for every g:U to V in S. The first step and naturality show G(g)(theta_V(s))=theta_U(rho_g(s))=theta-prime_U(rho_g(s))=G(g)(theta-prime_V(s)) on every arrow in S.

Use sheaf separatedness to conclude theta_V(s)=theta-prime_V(s). In Lean, the free abelian group ULift Z corepresents the forgetful functor on AddCommGrpCat in the independent target universe. Whiskering its coyoneda isomorphism with G transfers hG evaluated at that free group to the sheaf condition for the underlying presheaf of types. Presieve.IsSheafFor.isSeparatedFor.ext now applies to the covering sieve S. Extensionality of linear maps and dependent functions gives theta=theta-prime. The argument uses no comparison of the target universe with the scheme universe.
